node.title: Re: Print a big string formatted and in multiple lines
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [alen129],

Please see [id://174051] - please use tags to format not only your code but your data as well.

To convert the string '\n' (that is, a literal backslash followed by the letter n) to a newline (perhaps plus something else), you could do

$Detail =~ s/\\n/\n/g; # or $Detail =~ s/\\n/
\n/g; # for HTML

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
